title: Sharp Dirichlet eigenvalue inequalities on triangles
summary: We prove sharp Dirichlet eigenvalue inequalities for planar triangles. We settle a conjecture of Laugesen and Siudeja by showing that the equilateral triangle uniquely minimizes a scale-invariant functional of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue, area, and perimeter. Consequences include an optimal two-term lower bound for the first Dirichlet eigenvalue in terms of area and perimeter. We also prove a Cheeger-type inequality with an explicit best constant considered by Parini.
